text: Use `cmd.Flags()` for the command's applicable flag set (`command.go:1643`). For categories, use `cmd.LocalFlags()` for locally defined flags and `cmd.InheritedFlags()` for flags inherited from parents; `InheritedFlags` returns a `FlagSet` assembled from parent persistent flags while excluding local overrides (`command.go:1669-1670,1695-1718`). Iterate a returned set with `VisitAll`, as demonstrated in `command.go:1713-1717`.
